title: 第1章 清风少年第2章 太虚宗
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
青风山
清风村
清晨
随着第一缕晨曦刺破夜幕，太阳缓缓升起，金色的阳光如同温柔的指尖，轻轻抚过大地。
洒落在一个凝神打坐的十一二岁的清秀少年身上，他的面容透着不属于这个年纪的成熟与坚毅。
清秀少年感受到阳光的触摸，随后将几缕紫气缓缓吸入体内，又慢慢吐出体内浊气，仿佛在进行一场与自然的亲密交流。
凌宇的眼睛慢慢睁开，结束了一晚上的吐纳修炼。
他深深吸了口气，感受着清新的空气充满肺部，然后慢慢呼出，心中一片宁静。
这是一种难以言喻的舒适感，仿佛他的灵魂都在这一呼一吸之间得到了净化。
众所周知，一日之计在于晨，特别是太阳初升的这一刻，是天地间灵气最为活跃、充沛的时候。
凌宇也不例外，他明白这几缕清晨紫气就顶平常数日苦修。
早起的鸟儿有虫吃，这句俗语用来形容他再合适不过。
修炼对他来说可是认真的，积少成多，他就是在这样不断的积累中，悄悄的甩开朝阳升起之时还在睡觉的家伙们一大截，就比如隔壁家还在熟睡的那个小胖子。
拥有成熟心态的他可不会浪费这大好时机，现在的每一份努力，可都是属于自己的。
说起来自己莫名其妙穿越这个光怪陆离的玄幻世界已经十二年了，哦不，如果算上娘胎里两年半的话，可就十四年多了。
这个世界的胎前教育就是这么玄幻，拥有秘法他们可以使婴儿在母亲体内待更长的时间。
以确保婴儿出生时拥有更好的灵根资质，虽然灵根这事全凭老天爷赏脸，但是有条件的人没人会放弃。
就像有人说生命一号可以提高记忆力一样，父母就算省吃俭用也要给你来几个疗程一个道理。
虽不能确定可以提高灵根品质，但炼体资质的提高是可以完全确定的，处于先天状态的婴儿经过灵药的滋补体质那都是杠杠滴。
现在想起来那段时光凌宇都是一阵后怕，在一个封闭的状态下，眼不能见、口不能言、手不能动、腿不能伸，想想都可怕。

你以为手脚可以乱动，那是不可能的，秘法又不是摆设。
还好那段痛苦的时间已经成为了过去式。
凌宇的修炼并没有因此而停止，他深深的吸了一口气，感受着清晨的空气，他的心中充满了宁静。
他知道，只有通过不断的修炼，他才能在这个世界中立足，才能找到属于自己的道路。
“凌宇，下来吃饭了！”苏婉清看着在阁楼上边发呆的儿子叫道。
“来了。”凌宇微笑着应了一声，随即一个翻身直接稳稳当当落在了苏婉清身旁。
“你这孩子还是这么急躁，放着好好的楼梯不走，净整这些花里胡哨的。”苏婉清笑骂道。
“娘，这叫灵活应变，还能锻炼我的身手呢。”凌宇笑嘻嘻地说。
苏婉清无奈地摇了摇头，“你呀，总是有那么多说辞。就算要锻炼身手，也得注意安全才行。”
凌宇拍着胸脯保证，“娘，你就放心吧，我的身手好着呢，不会有问题的。”
苏婉清轻轻捏了捏凌宇的脸颊，温柔地说：“行，那你记住不管做什么都要小心，别让娘担心，我已经做好了饭菜，快去叫你爹一块来吃饭。”
小的时候凌宇还不太适应，毕竟上一世自己也是一个成年人了，叫陌生人爹娘还有点不习惯，但后来也就慢慢习惯了。
content_en:
Qingfeng Mountain
Qingfeng Village
early morning
As the first ray of morning light pierces the night, the sun rises slowly, and the golden sunshine is like gentle fingertips, gently caressing the earth.
It fell on a handsome eleven or twelve-year-old boy who was meditating attentively. His face revealed a maturity and perseverance that was beyond his age.
The handsome young man felt the touch of the sun, then slowly inhaled a few wisps of purple air into his body, and then slowly exhaled the turbid air in his body, as if he was having an intimate communication with nature.
Ling Yu's eyes slowly opened, ending a night of breathing practice.
He took a deep breath, feeling the fresh air fill his lungs, and then slowly exhaled, feeling peaceful in his heart.
It was an indescribable feeling of comfort, as if his soul was being purified with each breath.
As we all know, the day's plan begins in the morning, especially the moment when the sun rises, when the spiritual energy between heaven and earth is most active and abundant.
Ling Yu is no exception. He understands that these few wisps of purple energy in the morning are equivalent to several days of hard training.
The early bird catches the worm. This proverb is perfect to describe him.
Cultivation is serious to him, and little things add up. It is through this continuous accumulation that he quietly gets rid of many of the guys who are still sleeping when the sun rises, such as the little fat guy next door who is still sleeping soundly.
With a mature mentality, he will not waste this great opportunity. Every effort now belongs to him.
Speaking of which, it has been twelve years since I inexplicably traveled through this bizarre fantasy world. Oh no, if you include the two and a half years in my mother's womb, it has been more than fourteen years.
The prenatal education in this world is so mysterious. With secret methods, they can make the baby stay in the mother's body longer.
In order to ensure that the baby has better spiritual root qualifications when he is born, although the spiritual root depends entirely on God's favor, no one who has the conditions will give up.
Just like some people say that Life No. 1 can improve your memory, it is true that your parents will give you several courses of treatment even if they are frugal.
Although it is not certain that the quality of spiritual roots can be improved, the improvement of body refining qualifications can be completely certain. Babies in the innate state will be able to nourish their bodies through the elixir.
Ling Yu is terrified now when he thinks about that time. In a closed state, he couldn't see, speak, move his hands, or stretch his legs. It was scary to think about it.
You think you can move your hands and feet, but that's impossible. The secret method is not a decoration.
Fortunately, that painful time is now a thing of the past.
Ling Yu's practice did not stop because of this. He took a deep breath and felt the morning air, and his heart was filled with tranquility.
He knows that only through continuous practice can he gain a foothold in this world and find his own path.
"Ling Yu, come down for dinner!" Su Wanqing shouted while looking at her son who was dazed in the attic.
"Here we come." Ling Yu responded with a smile, then turned over and landed firmly next to Su Wanqing.
"You kid are still so impatient. You don't take the good stairs, but all these bells and whistles." Su Wanqing scolded with a smile.
"Mom, this is called flexibility, and it can also train my skills." Ling Yu said with a smile.
Su Wanqing shook her head helplessly, "You always have so many excuses. Even if you want to exercise your skills, you have to pay attention to safety."
Ling Yu patted his chest and assured, "Mom, don't worry, my skills are good, there will be no problem."
Su Wanqing pinched Ling Yu's cheek gently and said softly: "Okay, then remember to be careful no matter what you do. Don't let mother worry. I have already prepared the food. Go and ask your father to come and eat with us."
When he was young, Ling Yu wasn't used to it. After all, he was an adult in his last life, so he was a little uncomfortable calling strangers his parents, but he gradually got used to it.
